---
title: "Declare the Native Runtime"
subtitle: "Review Spack requirements before building"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

`spack.yaml` declares the native runtime. R 4.5.1 is retained from the
existing environment. The scientific workflow remains command-line-driven.

The `x86_64_v3` baseline avoids tying the image to the build node. The system
libraries follow the ERA5 and Nepal Climate Health examples, with the spatial
requirements traced to legacy stages 5–7 and their shared utility script.

The native layer includes both FlexiBLAS, which Spack's R installation uses,
and OpenBLAS. The latter is an explicit runtime requirement because binary R
packages resolved by `uvr` can link directly to the `libopenblas.so.0` SONAME
instead of going through R's FlexiBLAS interface. Declaring OpenBLAS as a root
spec ensures that its shared libraries are linked into the final Spack view.

The geospatial layer is a coherent Spack build of GDAL, GEOS, PROJ, SQLite,
and UDUNITS-2. `sf` needs GDAL/GEOS/PROJ; its R dependency `units` needs
`libudunits2.so.0`. Declaring `sf` in `uvr.toml` installs R code but cannot
provide these native libraries. In the previous image, `ldd` reported missing
UDUNITS, GDAL, GEOS, and PROJ libraries, so changing the existing search path
would not repair the runtime. The installed binary also requested
`libgdal.so.30`; a newer GDAL can have a different ABI. Build R packages from
source against this image, as described on [page 14](14_page-uvr.qmd).

| Native requirement | Evidence and purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `gdal`, `geos`, `proj`, `sqlite` | `sf` reads administrative polygons, repairs/unions geometry, evaluates DE-9IM relations, and transforms CRS; GDAL also supports raster packages in the mapping dependency closure |
| `udunits` | R `units`, used by `sf` areas and distances; includes its XML unit database |
| `abseil-cpp`, `openssl`, `cmake`, `pkgconf` | R `s2` spherical geometry and native build discovery |
| `glpk`, BLAS/LAPACK | `igraph` connected components and numerical dependencies; GLPK was already part of the runtime |
| `cairo`, font and image libraries, `libwebp +libwebpmux` | Headless stage-5 map/plot exports and graphics packages in the `tmap`/`ggpubr` dependency closure |
| Final-image `dejavu-sans-fonts` | Actual font files for headless map labels; `fontconfig` discovers fonts but does not supply them |
| R `+X` variant | Spack enables R's Cairo/PNG/JPEG/TIFF devices through this variant; Cairo exports run without a display server |
| Final-image `gcc`, `gcc-c++`, `gcc-gfortran`, `make` | Compile R packages against the image, including Fortran dependencies of graph/statistical plotting packages |

These are native libraries, not Spack `r-*` packages: `uvr` continues to own
the R package closure. No Python runtime, external Arrow C++ installation,
or replacement spatial file format is needed by the reviewed stages.
See the upstream [sf installation requirements](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/)
and [s2 installation requirements](https://r-spatial.github.io/s2/).

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Runtime Policy"}

Before building, review the R, Rocky Linux, Spack, and CPU target
versions below. None of these choices are inferred from protected data.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-config-yaml file="{{ emit.project_root }}/spack.yaml" title="Emit The Runtime Declaration"}

```yaml
spack:
  specs:
  - r@4.5.1+X
  - gdal
  - geos
  - proj
  - sqlite
  - udunits
  - abseil-cpp
  - pkgconf
  - libxml2
  - icu4c
  - libx11
  - git
  - curl
  - openssl
  - libgit2
  - cmake
  - gmake
  - freetype
  - libjpeg-turbo
  - libpng
  - libtiff
  - libwebp +libwebpmux
  - cairo
  - fontconfig
  - fribidi
  - harfbuzz
  - libuv
  - glpk
  - flexiblas
  - openblas
  view: true
  concretizer:
    unify: true
  packages:
    all:
      require:
      - target=x86_64_v3
  config:
    template_dirs:
    - $env/containers/templates
    - $spack/share/spack/templates
  container:
    format: singularity
    images:
      os: rockylinux:9
      spack: 1.2.0
    template: MDGHealthshedClinicData.def.j2
    os_packages:
      final:
      - ca-certificates
      - findutils
      - gzip
      - tar
      - which
      - gcc
      - gcc-c++
      - gcc-gfortran
      - dejavu-sans-fonts
      - make
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Declaration"}

```sh
rg -n 'r@4.5.1|flexiblas|openblas|target=x86_64_v3|rockylinux:9' spack.yaml
rg -n 'gdal|geos|proj|sqlite|udunits|abseil-cpp|pkgconf|cairo|libwebpmux|gcc-gfortran' spack.yaml
```

:::
